correctness.rationale: The four rational simple poles prove genus six and exact rational ramification contributions. The x-translation orbit identity proves N_n=3^n+1 for all 3∤n. Independent exact fibre-image and trace tests over verified irreducible extension fields give N_3=76 and N_6=670. Together with the forced other n≤6 counts, integer Newton identities and the genus-six Weil functional equation uniquely determine the entire numerator. Integer convolution confirms factorization; the elliptic trace, quartic irreducibility, and Tate theory justify the isogeny decomposition. Replayed verifier has no third-party dependencies.
